blocks.body:
name = "acme/clock-midnight"
version = "1.0.0"
[agent]
timeout = "30m"
network = "none"

[sandbox]
timezone = "America/New_York"
clock = { start = "2026-03-14T23:40:00-04:00", enforce = "preload" }

diagnostics.message: the run can cross midnight in America/New_York: it starts at 23:40 and may run 30m, so the agent's date can change during the run while TASKMD_CLOCK_START keeps the start's date. Start earlier in the day, or have the verifier read TASKMD_CLOCK_HANDOFF
